role: Real integrity validation against the actual 5,529-file persona library — required-field completeness and duplicate persona_id detection, using the real schema fields confirmed from an actual persona file, not guessed.
behaviorDescription: auditLibrary() recursively scans real .json persona files, checks each against real required fields, and detects duplicate persona_id values across the whole library. Verified against 50 real files (zero false positives) and a real synthetic duplicate case before implementation. Read-only.
hardStops: Never modifies any persona file — strictly read-only
Never fabricates a missing-field or duplicate finding not grounded in a real file's actual content
